queries.name: Daftar Invoice Belum Lunas
queries.purpose: Menampilkan daftar detail invoice penjualan customer yang masih memiliki outstanding beserta aging hari dan bucket umur piutang.
queries.query: SELECT si.siid AS invoice_id, si.sinotransaksi AS nomor_invoice, si.sitgl AS tanggal_invoice, si.sitgljatuhtempo AS tanggal_jatuh_tempo, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, si.simatauang AS mata_uang, si.sitotaltransaksi AS total_invoice, COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) AS total_terbayar, (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS outstanding, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 0 ELSE DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) END AS aging_days, CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'No Due Date' WHEN CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 'Current' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '>90' END AS aging_bucket, si.sistatuslunas AS status_lunas, si.sistatus AS status_dokumen FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 ORDER BY outstanding DESC, si.sitgl ASC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Outstanding dan Risiko per Customer
queries.purpose: Menghitung total outstanding per customer dan memberi ranking customer dengan risiko keterlambatan tertinggi berdasarkan nominal overdue, jumlah invoice overdue, dan hari overdue maksimum.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice_belum_lunas, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jumlah_invoice_overdue, SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) ELSE 0 END) AS total_overdue, MAX(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) ELSE 0 END) AS maksimum_hari_overdue, ROUND((SUM(CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NOT NULL AND CURDATE() > si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)), 0)) * 100, 2) AS persen_overdue_dari_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY total_overdue DESC, maksimum_hari_overdue DESC, total_outstanding DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Distribusi Aging Bucket
queries.purpose: Menampilkan distribusi outstanding piutang berdasarkan bucket umur piutang untuk melihat komposisi current vs overdue.
queries.query: SELECT CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'No Due Date' WHEN CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 'Current' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '>90' END AS aging_bucket, COUNT(si.siid) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) AS total_outstanding FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0)) > 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN si.sitgljatuhtempo IS NULL THEN 'No Due Date' WHEN CURDATE() <= si.sitgljatuhtempo THEN 'Current' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), si.sitgljatuhtempo) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '>90' END ORDER BY CASE aging_bucket WHEN 'Current' THEN 1 WHEN '1-30' THEN 2 WHEN '31-60' THEN 3 WHEN '61-90' THEN 4 WHEN '>90' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END

queries.query: SELECT status_invoice_collection_pv, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_invoice, SUM(nilai_invoice) AS total_nilai_invoice, SUM(total_tertagih_ic) AS total_nilai_tertagih_ic, SUM(total_dibayar_pv) AS total_nilai_dibayar_pv, SUM(sisa_outstanding) AS total_sisa_outstanding FROM ( SELECT si.siid, si.sitotaltransaksi AS nilai_invoice, COALESCE(ic.total_tertagih_ic, 0) AS total_tertagih_ic, COALESCE(pv.total_dibayar_pv, 0) AS total_dibayar_pv, (si.sitotaltransaksi - COALESCE(pv.total_dibayar_pv, 0)) AS sisa_outstanding, CASE WHEN COALESCE(ic.jumlah_ic_detail, 0) = 0 THEN 'BELUM TERTAGIH' WHEN COALESCE(pv.total_dibayar_pv, 0) = 0 THEN 'SUDAH TERTAGIH BELUM DIBAYAR' WHEN COALESCE(pv.total_dibayar_pv, 0) < si.sitotaltransaksi THEN 'SUDAH DIBAYAR SEBAGIAN' ELSE 'SUDAH DIBAYAR / LUNAS' END AS status_invoice_collection_pv FROM m5_si si LEFT JOIN ( SELECT idtransaksi AS siid, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_ic_detail, SUM(jmlbayar) AS total_tertagih_ic FROM m5_ic_detail WHERE sumber = 'SI' GROUP BY idtransaksi ) ic ON ic.siid = si.siid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT idtransaksi AS siid, SUM(jmlbayar) AS total_dibayar_pv FROM m5_pv_detail WHERE sumber = 'SI' GROUP BY idtransaksi ) pv ON pv.siid = si.siid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 ) status_data GROUP BY status_invoice_collection_pv ORDER BY total_nilai_invoice DESC

queries.name: Ringkasan Hubungan per Customer
queries.purpose: Merangkum jumlah sales invoice, sales return, nilai retur, dan jumlah dokumen tukar faktur per customer.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COALESCE(si.total_invoice, 0) AS jumlah_sales_invoice, COALESCE(si.nilai_invoice, 0) AS nilai_sales_invoice, COALESCE(sr.total_return, 0) AS jumlah_sales_return, COALESCE(sr.nilai_return, 0) AS nilai_sales_return, COALESCE(sie.total_tukar_faktur, 0) AS jumlah_tukar_faktur, COALESCE(sie.invoice_di_tukar, 0) AS invoice_terlibat_tukar_faktur, COALESCE(sie.return_di_tukar, 0) AS retur_terlibat_tukar_faktur FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.sicustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.siid) AS total_invoice, SUM(s.sitotaltransaksi) AS nilai_invoice FROM m5_si s WHERE s.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY s.sicustomer ) si ON si.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.srcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.srid) AS total_return, SUM(r.srtotaltransaksi) AS nilai_return FROM m5_sr r GROUP BY r.srcustomer ) sr ON sr.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.sieid) AS total_tukar_faktur, COUNT(DISTINCT x.siid) AS invoice_di_tukar, COUNT(DISTINCT x.srid) AS return_di_tukar FROM ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, sd.idsie AS sieid, si.siid AS siid, NULL AS srid FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_si si ON sd.sumber = 'SI' AND sd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND si.siisclose = 0 UNION ALL SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, sd.idsie AS sieid, NULL AS siid, sr.srid AS srid FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_sr sr ON sd.sumber = 'SR' AND sd.idtransaksi = sr.srid ) x GROUP BY x.customer_id ) sie ON sie.customer_id = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(si.total_invoice, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sr.total_return, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(sie.total_tukar_faktur, 0) > 0) ORDER BY nilai_sales_return DESC, jumlah_tukar_faktur DESC, nama_customer ASC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Distribusi Pola Retur dan Tukar Faktur
queries.purpose: Mengelompokkan customer berdasarkan kombinasi adanya retur dan tukar faktur.
queries.query: SELECT pattern_label, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_customer FROM ( SELECT c.kid, CASE WHEN COALESCE(sr.total_return, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(sie.total_tukar_faktur, 0) > 0 THEN 'Retur + Tukar Faktur' WHEN COALESCE(sr.total_return, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(sie.total_tukar_faktur, 0) = 0 THEN 'Retur Saja' WHEN COALESCE(sr.total_return, 0) = 0 AND COALESCE(sie.total_tukar_faktur, 0) > 0 THEN 'Tukar Faktur Saja' ELSE 'Invoice Saja / Tanpa Relasi Lanjutan' END AS pattern_label FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.sicustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT s.siid) AS total_invoice FROM m5_si s WHERE s.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY s.sicustomer ) si ON si.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT r.srcustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT r.srid) AS total_return FROM m5_sr r GROUP BY r.srcustomer ) sr ON sr.customer_id = c.kid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT x.customer_id, COUNT(DISTINCT x.sieid) AS total_tukar_faktur FROM ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, sd.idsie AS sieid FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_si si ON sd.sumber = 'SI' AND sd.idtransaksi = si.siid AND si.siisclose = 0 UNION ALL SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, sd.idsie AS sieid FROM m5_sie_detail sd INNER JOIN m5_sr sr ON sd.sumber = 'SR' AND sd.idtransaksi = sr.srid ) x GROUP BY x.customer_id ) sie ON sie.customer_id = c.kid WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND COALESCE(si.total_invoice, 0) > 0 ) base GROUP BY pattern_label ORDER BY jumlah_customer DESC

queries.name: Detail Hubungan Dokumen

debug_info.intent_user: User meminta dashboard customer berisiko di area penjualan berdasarkan gabungan indikator: outstanding piutang tinggi, aging invoice panjang, retur tinggi, collection/pelunasan lambat, dan fulfillment sales order yang macet.
debug_info.reasoning: Permintaan ini secara natural membutuhkan beberapa blok analitik, jadi dipakai mode dashboard. Untuk outstanding, aging, dan collection lambat, tabel paling tepat adalah header sales invoice m5_si karena ada total transaksi, jumlah bayar, status lunas, tanggal invoice, tanggal jatuh tempo, dan tanggal lunas; juga ada relasi customer ke m1_contact serta always_apply_filters siisclose = 0 yang wajib diterapkan. Untuk retur tinggi, dipakai header sales return m5_sr agar bisa agregasi nilai retur per customer. Untuk fulfillment macet, dipakai header sales order m5_so karena tersedia status lintas tahap dan tanggal order; open fulfillment diperkirakan dari status realisasi belum selesai serta umur order yang sudah lama. Query 1 membuat ranking customer risk dengan menggabungkan metrik invoice outstanding/aging/collection lambat dengan agregat retur dan fulfillment dalam subquery per customer. Query 2 memberi rincian aging bucket outstanding per customer untuk konteks risiko piutang. Query 3 memberi daftar sales order customer yang fulfillment-nya macet berdasarkan statusrealisasi yang belum selesai dan umur order yang panjang. Saya tidak memakai window function. Saya juga tidak join polymorphic idtransaksi secara langsung karena tidak diperlukan.

linting_warnings: Query dashboard agregat berpotensi full scan jika volume transaksi besar karena user tidak memberi filter periode.
Logika 'collection lambat' dan 'fulfillment macet' diturunkan dari field status/tanggal yang tersedia; definisi bisnis final bisa berbeda dari report legacy.

queries.name: Ranking Customer Berisiko
queries.purpose: Merangking customer berdasarkan gabungan outstanding, aging, retur, collection lambat, dan fulfillment macet.
queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COALESCE(inv.total_outstanding, 0) AS total_outstanding, COALESCE(inv.max_aging_days, 0) AS max_aging_days, COALESCE(inv.avg_collection_days, 0) AS avg_collection_days, COALESCE(ret.total_retur, 0) AS total_retur, COALESCE(ful.open_so_count, 0) AS open_so_count, COALESCE(ful.overdue_so_count, 0) AS overdue_so_count, (COALESCE(inv.total_outstanding, 0) + (COALESCE(inv.max_aging_days, 0) * 1000) + (COALESCE(inv.avg_collection_days, 0) * 500) + COALESCE(ret.total_retur, 0) + (COALESCE(ful.overdue_so_count, 0) * 100000)) AS risk_score FROM m1_contact c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT si.sicustomer AS customer_id, SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) > COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS total_outstanding, MAX(CASE WHEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) > COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) THEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)) ELSE 0 END) AS max_aging_days, AVG(CASE WHEN si.sitgllunas IS NOT NULL THEN DATEDIFF(si.sitgllunas, si.sitgl) END) AS avg_collection_days FROM m5_si si WHERE si.siisclose = 0 GROUP BY si.sicustomer ) inv ON c.kid = inv.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sr.srcustomer AS customer_id, SUM(COALESCE(sr.srtotaltransaksi, 0)) AS total_retur, COUNT(sr.srid) AS jumlah_retur FROM m5_sr sr GROUP BY sr.srcustomer ) ret ON c.kid = ret.customer_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT so.socustomer AS customer_id, COUNT(so.soid) AS open_so_count, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), so.sotgl) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS overdue_so_count FROM m5_so so WHERE so.soisclose = 0 AND (so.sostatusrealisasi IS NULL OR so.sostatusrealisasi NOT IN ('SELESAI','LUNAS','CLOSE','CLOSED')) GROUP BY so.socustomer ) ful ON c.kid = ful.customer_id WHERE c.kaktif = 1 AND (COALESCE(inv.total_outstanding, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(ret.total_retur, 0) > 0 OR COALESCE(ful.open_so_count, 0) > 0) ORDER BY risk_score DESC, total_outstanding DESC, max_aging_days DESC LIMIT 100

queries.name: Aging Outstanding per Customer

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)) <= 30 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_0_30, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)) BETWEEN 31 AND 60 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_31_60, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)) BETWEEN 61 AND 90 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_61_90, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), COALESCE(si.sitgljatuhtempo, si.sitgl)) > 90 THEN COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) - COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS outstanding_gt_90 FROM m5_si si INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON si.sicustomer = c.kid WHERE si.siisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND COALESCE(si.sitotaltransaksi, 0) > COALESCE(si.sijmlbayar, 0) GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY outstanding_gt_90 DESC, outstanding_61_90 DESC, outstanding_31_60 DESC LIMIT 100

queries.query: SELECT c.kid AS customer_id, c.kkode AS kode_customer, c.knama AS nama_customer, COUNT(so.soid) AS jumlah_so_macet, MIN(so.sotgl) AS so_tertua, MAX(DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), so.sotgl)) AS usia_so_terlama_hari, SUM(COALESCE(so.sototaltransaksi, 0)) AS total_nilai_so_macet FROM m5_so so INNER JOIN m1_contact c ON so.socustomer = c.kid WHERE so.soisclose = 0 AND c.kaktif = 1 AND (so.sostatusrealisasi IS NULL OR so.sostatusrealisasi NOT IN ('SELESAI','LUNAS','CLOSE','CLOSED')) AND DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), so.sotgl) > 30 GROUP BY c.kid, c.kkode, c.knama ORDER BY jumlah_so_macet DESC, usia_so_terlama_hari DESC, total_nilai_so_macet DESC LIMIT 100
